share.title: Share {name}
share.description: Invite people to view or edit this project.
share.viewerNote: You can view this project. People who can edit it invite others.
share.copyFailed: The browser blocked the copy. Select the link and copy it.
share.workspaceAccessHelp: What the people in {workspace} can do
share.restrictedOwnerOnly: Only the owner can set or clear Restricted.
share.linkHelp: Anyone with the link joins with this role. The link expires on {date}.

readOnly.composer: You can view this project. Ask its owner for edit access to change it.
readOnly.editorsOnly: Only people who can edit this project can do this.

credits.payerEmpty: The workspace of this project is out of credits. Ask its owner to add credits.

domains.managersOnly: Owners and admins of the workspace of this project manage its domains.
domains.otherWorkspace: Owners and admins of the workspace of this project manage its domains. Open the project from that workspace.

settings.capsAdminsOnly: Only the owner and the admins of this project can see and change the spending limits.
settings.capsOwnerOnly: Only the owner of this project can see and change the spending limits.
settings.deleteOwnerOnly: Only the owner of this project can delete it.
settings.transferHelp: Make another owner, admin, or editor of {workspace} the owner of this project.
settings.transferNoCandidates: No other owner, admin, or editor is in this workspace.
settings.transferConfirmBody: After the transfer, your workspace role decides your access to this project.
settings.moveHelp: The new workspace pays for this project from now on. The backend and the secrets move with it.
settings.moveNoDestinations: You have no other workspace where you can create projects.
settings.moveKeepCollaborators: Keep the people invited to this project
settings.moveConfirmBody: The invite link stops working. Members of this workspace lose access, unless they have a direct invitation that you keep.

moveBlocked.turn_active: A builder turn is still running or waiting. Stop it, then move the project.
moveBlocked.usage_reserved: Credits are still held for this project. Try again in a few minutes.
moveBlocked.publish_in_flight: A publish is in progress. Try again when it ends.
moveBlocked.mobile_build_in_flight: A mobile build is in progress. Try again when it ends.
moveBlocked.desktop_build_in_flight: A desktop build is in progress. Try again when it ends.
moveBlocked.device_session_active: A phone preview session is open. Close it, then move the project.
moveBlocked.custom_domain_attached: A custom domain is connected. Remove it, then move the project.
moveBlocked.backend_slot_unavailable: The destination workspace has no free backend slot.

invite.title: Project invitation
invite.signInFirst: Sign in with the email address that got the invitation.
invite.invitedTo: {inviter} invited you to the project {project} in {workspace}.
invite.invalid: This invitation is not valid. It can be for another email address.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask {inviter} to invite you again.
invite.notPending: This invitation was already used or canceled.
